item.title: DESTINY model tracks molecular chemistry on uneven, ice-covered grains in interstellar space
item.description: Interstellar space is the scene of active chemical processes: molecules form there in the gas, but also on the surface of tiny dust grains covered in ice. The paper is published in the journal Astronomy & Astrophysics. Fuente: Phys.org.
